_curation_notes: conveyor-belts-huang.jpg, steampunk-worker-sparrow.jpg, and dieselpunk-concept-tapedamage.jpg dropped from the pool per Alex's curatorial pass (huang is a tutorial diagram, sparrow's worker is off-model, tapedamage gas-mask portrait reads too grim/post-apocalyptic for the labor cohort). Files retained on disk for possible future re-evaluation. Miku inserts now affinity-pinned to the Miku card's page so all the headline visual energy concentrates there; we limit to 1 Miku insert per page so the card and the fan-art are a pair, not a stack. The dazzel purple geometric one is preferred — listed first so it wins when only one slot is available. Scryfall art_crop URLs added as wide inserts so the binder pool has enough density to fill 3 pages of 3x3 without recycling, and so a chunk of the thesis-art is official Wizards illustration rather than 100% DeviantArt sourcing.
